card.title: When Things Made Sense
card.instruction: Perform the person you were before reality became complicated, using outdated certainty to explain each new impossibility.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I was caretaker, this door opened into the staffroom. What's all this Thursday business?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It opens into next Thursday. My coat's still in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Calendar's been fitted backwards. I'll turn it round.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's last Thursday. My coat hasn't arrived yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wrong-size calendar. Fetch the old one. We never lost a coat to a properly fitted door.

mechanism: A returns to a former caretaker identity and treats a time-shifting door as a calendar-fitting error solvable with old equipment.
confusable: Unlike accepting time travel and managing its logistics, A explains each impossible outcome with obsolete ordinary maintenance certainty.
comparison: The door alternative doubles down after a attempted calendar fix changes the day; the kettle alternative changes familiar fault diagnoses as its behavior shifts.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
